inShort: A dinks into B's backhand corner and makes B reach. B covers about 70% of the kitchen's width and still lands every dink.
rules: A and B dink from backhand corner to backhand corner, diagonally across at the kitchen line.
On B's side, put a cone a quarter of the way into the other half. B covers everything from the sideline to the cone: about 70% of the width.
A dinks anywhere in B's zone, wide and short, so B has to reach.
B stretches and still lands every dink.
Pulled far out of position? Play the safe ball: to A's forehand or the middle, not another wide one.
Go for 15 dinks in a row without a pop-up. Then swap roles.
tooEasy: Move the cone further, so B covers more. Even harder: run the forehand corner too, and only dinks inside the kitchen count.
tooHard: Move the cone toward the middle, so B covers less.
goodLooksLike: B stays low while stretching, and the ball still lands soft in the kitchen.
